downRule.coreExposure: The core is attackable only while its owner is downed or under crowd control.

launchRule.wallDamage: 15 to 36 from impact speed within the current combo budget
launchRule.rule: Knockback becomes high-speed physical launch velocity; visible arena bounds and covers reflect the victim and deal bonus damage.

comboRule.finisher: Each career has a three-to-six beat normal string; only its authored final beat launches.
comboRule.escape: A ready Space mobility breaks hitstun and grants 0.72 seconds of combo immunity.
comboRule.damageCap: Each completed string plus its wall collision damage is limited to 38-50% of max HP, requiring two strings for fragile careers and three for heavy careers.

chargeSkillRule.scales: damage, reach, radius, crowd control, knockback, and career-specific projectile count
chargeSkillRule.cancel: Starting charge cancels normal recovery; Q and Space cancel charge and normal recovery immediately.

normalAttackRule: LMB advances an authored rhythmic string. Only shotgun, sniper, and dual pistols use projectile normals; the other nine careers use direct weapon/body/placed-blast hit regions.

normalAttacks.rhythm: short placement / long placement / cluster finish
hook lashes ending in a hard inward pull
two weighted swings into a floor-breaking smash
alternating taps / double tap / triple finish
left cut / right cut / rising cut / draw finish
five rapid body blows into one planted punch
two quick fuses into a large delayed finish
increasing thrust reach into a committed impale
three captures into a heavy inward whip

ultimate.normalHitCharge: 1.5 + 0.38 * applied damage, capped at 7 per confirmed projectile
ultimate.effectRule: The twelve ultimates include radial scatter, rail strikes, mortar denial, drain pulses, hammer shockwave, homing storm, crossing katana cuts, fist rush, walking bomb chain, piercing spear lines, chain vortex, and a fortified shield overturn. Projectile and zone skills can both damage an exposed core.
